name: ai-team-en
description: AI Team Starter (English) — set up your own AI team in a working folder: an AGENTS.md constitution, a START-HERE.md folder map, a user profile, assistants in a standard format, projects with a source of truth, and memory that saves lessons every session. Right after install, the agent offers setup.

interface.shortDescription: Set up an AGENTS.md constitution, a memory folder and named AI assistants for your working folder
interface.longDescription: After install, Codex asks you a few questions, then builds AGENTS.md (constitution), START-HERE.md (folder map), an about-me.md profile and a memory/ folder. At the end of each task the agent runs save-session to log the session, lessons and knowledge. Add more when you need it: add-assistant, add-project, organize-folder, add-lesson, tidy-memory, health-check.
